title: WSL heartbeat timer (infra-2 root cause of W-97557e65/W-1d9ba411, 2026-10-29): the hotel-wifi watchdog's wsl.exe curl probe leaks ~1 root /init relay per 7 runs (each pins a 512 KB hv_sock ring → order-7 failures → wsl.exe hang). Build a user systemd timer, every 60 s: curl -sf -m 5 -o /dev/null http://www.msftconnecttest.com/connecttest.txt && touch /mnt/c/Users/user/hotel-wifi/wsl-net-ok, so the operator's ps1 reads the heartbeat's age instead of launching wsl.exe. New mechanism → /fabrik-task.
